title: Leveraging a QSP Platform for Prediction of Clinical Efficacy and Safety Biomarkers in Immuno-Oncology Combination Therapy
summary: Learn how Certara's IO Simulator QSP platform predicts combination efficacy and cytokine biomarkers of cytokine release syndrome, using a tarlatamab case study.
body_markdown:
ShareShareShare


**Publication:** Clinical Pharmacology & Therapeutics


## Abstract


The IO Simulator™ is a Quantitative Systems Pharmacology platform implementing a mechanistic model of solid tumor–immune system interactions and the action of standard immuno-oncology drugs. Using a tarlatamab case study, the authors show how IO Simulator predicts combination therapy efficacy and cytokine biomarkers, which can be statistically related to the risk of cytokine release syndrome (CRS). This allows patient stratification and identification of doses that maximize efficacy without a substantial increase in cytokine release.


**Authors:** Daniela Santurio, Sirin Yonucu, Aiman Alam-Nazki, Birses Debir, Maciej Swat, Rachel H. Rose, Inmaculada C. Sorribes, Miao Zhao, Tomoko Freshwater, Piet H. van der Graaf, Andrzej M. Kierzek


**Published:** October 7, 2026
